test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: After allowing a discount of 64%, the value of a water cooler is ₹6,480. If no discount is allowed, then the shopkeeper gains 20%. Find the cost price (in ₹) of the water cooler
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

SP = 36% of MP ⇒ 6,480 = 0.36 × MP ⇒ MP = 18,000.

If no discount is allowed, SP = MP = 18,000.

At this SP, profit is 20%, so CP × 1.2 = 18,000.

CP = 18,000 ÷ 1.2 = 15,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Discount = 64%, SP = ₹6,480, Profit (at MP) = 20%.

**Formulas:** SP = MP × (100 − D%) ÷ 100 | CP = MP × 100 ÷ (100 + P%)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fd60b1d99cc640c146fdfeafa1f36535fad552ec01b6b9451c652ac63fc8dc8.png] 

⇒ Let **Marked Price** be MP.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − 64) ÷ 100 = 0.36 × MP.

⇒ 6,480 = 0.36 × MP ⇒ MP = 6,480 ÷ 0.36 = 18,000.

⇒ If no discount is allowed, then **New SP = MP** = 18,000.

⇒ Given **Profit** = 20% when SP = 18,000.

⇒ Cost Price (CP) = 18,000 × (100 ÷ 120) = 18,000 ÷ 1.2 = 15,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹15,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between CP and MP

The direct ratio of CP to MP is given by CP : MP = (100 − Discount%) : (100 + Profit%).

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**, and if no discount is offered, the Marked Price becomes the Selling Price.
